result.instructions: Tools for CCV Shop, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the orders from this week that are not paid yet."; "Which products have the lowest stock, and what are their product numbers?"; "List the customers who signed up and still wait for approval.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CCV Shop data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ccvshop_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ccvshop_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ccvshop_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ccvshop_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products of this webshop, filtered by product number, EAN or a part of the name. Returns items with ids, prices and stock. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/products/.

productname.description: Part of the product name (at least 3 characters).

size.description: Maximum number of items to return.

orderby.description: Field to sort by. Add _desc to reverse, e.g. create_date_desc (see the list tool's description).

tools.name: ccvshop_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product by id, with its prices, stock, description and attributes. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/products/{id}/.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders of this webshop. Filter by order number, status, paid state or a creation date range (yyyy-mm-dd). Use this to find recent sales. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/orders/.

status.description: Order status code (as set in the webshop).

min_create_date.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

max_create_date.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

size.description: Maximum number of items to return.

orderby.description: Field to sort by. Add _desc to reverse, e.g. create_date_desc (see the list tool's description).

tools.name: ccvshop_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by id: customer, totals, payment and delivery data. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/orders/{id}/.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_order_rows
tools.title: List order rows
tools.description: List the order lines (products, quantities, prices) of one order. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/orders/{id}/orderrows/.

size.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: ccvshop_add_order_note
tools.title: Add an internal order note
tools.description: Add an INTERNAL note to one order. The note is not emailed to the customer and does not change the order. Uses POST /api/rest/v1/orders/{id}/ordernotes/.

note.description: The text of the internal note.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List the product categories of this webshop. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/categories/.

size.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_brands
tools.title: List brands
tools.description: List the brands of this webshop. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/brands/.

size.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers of this webshop. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/suppliers/.

size.description: Maximum number of items to return.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of this webshop. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/invoices/.

size.description: Maximum number of items to return.

orderby.description: Field to sort by. Add _desc to reverse, e.g. create_date_desc (see the list tool's description).

tools.name: ccvshop_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/invoices/{id}/.

tools.name: ccvshop_list_users
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the customer accounts (users) of this webshop, optionally by approval status (pending or accepted). Uses GET /api/rest/v1/users/.

approval_status.description: Only pending or only accepted accounts.

size.description: Maximum number of items to return.

orderby.description: Field to sort by: id, first_name or last_name (add _desc to reverse).

tools.name: ccvshop_get_user
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer account (user) by id. Uses GET /api/rest/v1/users/{id}/.
